about: Agent-behavior cases: a user request, the commands an agent following SKILL.md should pick, where it must ask first, and what its final report must say. Score an agent by hand or with a grader; smoke_test.py only checks that every named script and flag exists.

cases.request: Change every 'Q3 revenue' to 'Q4 revenue' in deck.pptx.
ask_before: matches in hidden slides or notes when the count differs from the user's

cases.request: How many slides will people see in deck.pptx?
Get deck.pptx ready to send to a client.
ask_before: removing notes, comments, hidden slides, macros or links

cases.request: Make a 3-slide deck from brand.potx with these bullet points.
Someone emailed me invoice.pptm; what's in it?
report: links and actions by host only

cases.request: Show me what slide 2 looks like (on a Mac).
ask_before: sending the file to Graph (cloud upload)
report: user opens the copy or exports a PDF from PowerPoint

cases.request: Combine a.pptx and b.pptx into one deck.
report: PowerPoint Reuse Slides or Office.js insertSlidesFromBase64
